sources.title: Qwen-Video-Edit: Instruction-Based Video Editing
sources.snippet: 1 Introduction Instruction-based video editing asks a model to modify a source video according to a free-form textual instruction—restyling a scene, replacing a subject, changing weather or materials—while preserving the content and motion that the instruction does not touch.
